standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Steady pace for people learning alongside work or studies.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.description: Fast track in about half the time. Alerts fire sooner.

levels.name: Python Basics
levels.project: Tip calculator: ask for a bill and tip %, then print the total.

topics.name: print()
topics.try: Print a welcome message with print('Hello').

topics.name: variables
topics.try: Store your name in a variable and print it.

topics.name: numbers and strings
topics.try: Use both a number (like 42) and a string (like 'hi') in one program.

topics.name: input()
topics.try: Ask for the user's name with input() and greet them.

topics.name: arithmetic and comparison operators
topics.try: Add two numbers, then check which is bigger with >.

topics.name: comments
topics.try: Explain a line of your code with a # comment.

levels.name: Control Flow
levels.project: Number guessing game with a limited number of tries.

topics.name: if / elif / else
topics.try: Print 'even' or 'odd' for a number using if / else.

topics.name: for loops
topics.try: Loop over a list of names and print each one.

topics.name: while loops
topics.try: Count down from 10 with a while loop.

topics.name: range()
topics.try: Print the 5 times table with for i in range(1, 11).

topics.name: break and continue
topics.try: Stop a loop early with break when the user types 'quit'.

levels.name: Data Structures
levels.project: Contact book stored in a dictionary (add, search, delete).

topics.name: lists
topics.try: Make a list of 3 fruits and print the second one.

topics.name: tuples
topics.try: Store a point as (x, y) and print both values.

topics.name: dictionaries
topics.try: Store a person's name and age in a dict and print them.

topics.name: sets
topics.try: Remove duplicates from a list with set().

topics.name: slicing
topics.try: Print the first 3 letters of a word with word[:3].

topics.name: list methods (append, sort…)
topics.try: Build a list with append() and then sort() it.

levels.name: Functions
levels.project: Calculator built from one function per operation.

topics.name: def (your own function)
topics.try: Write def say_hello(): and call it.

topics.name: parameters
topics.try: Write def greet(name): that prints a greeting for any name.

topics.name: return
topics.try: Write def add(a, b): return a + b and print the result.

topics.name: default arguments
topics.try: Write greet(name, greeting='Hello') and call it with and without the second argument.

topics.name: lambda
topics.try: Sort a list of tuples with sorted(items, key=lambda x: x[1]).

topics.name: scope (global / nonlocal)
topics.try: Change a counter inside a function using the global keyword.

levels.name: Files & Errors
levels.project: To-do list that saves to a JSON file and handles bad input.

topics.name: open() with 'with'
topics.try: Open a file using with open('notes.txt', 'w') as f:.

topics.name: reading files
topics.try: Read a text file with f.read() and print it.

topics.name: writing files
topics.try: Write three lines to a file with f.write().

topics.name: try / except
topics.try: Wrap int(input()) in try / except ValueError.

topics.name: raise
topics.try: raise ValueError when someone enters a negative age.

topics.name: json
topics.try: Save a dict to a file with json.dump() and load it back.

levels.name: Modules & Packages
levels.project: Split the to-do app into two modules and add dates with datetime.

topics.name: import
topics.try: import math and print math.sqrt(16).

topics.name: from … import
topics.try: from random import randint and roll a dice.

topics.name: standard library (math, random, datetime…)
topics.try: Print today's date using the datetime module.

topics.name: importing your own module
topics.try: Put a function in helpers.py and import it from main.py (same folder).

topics.name: a package installed with pip
topics.try: Run pip install requests (or colorama), then import it.

levels.name: Object-Oriented Programming
levels.project: Bank account system: Account, SavingsAccount and transactions.

topics.name: class
topics.try: Create a class Dog and make an object from it.

topics.name: __init__ and self
topics.try: Give Dog an __init__(self, name) that stores the name.

topics.name: methods
topics.try: Add a bark(self) method and call it.

topics.name: inheritance
topics.try: Make class Puppy(Dog) and override one method.

topics.name: special methods (__str__, __repr__…)
topics.try: Add __str__ so print(dog) shows a friendly description.

topics.name: class attributes
topics.try: Add species = 'dog' directly inside the class body.

levels.name: Advanced Python
levels.project: Log-file analyser using a generator and a timing decorator.

topics.name: list / dict comprehensions
topics.try: Build squares = [n * n for n in range(10)].

topics.name: generators (yield)
topics.try: Write a function that yields numbers one at a time.

topics.name: decorators
topics.try: Write a @timer decorator that prints how long a function took.

topics.name: your own context manager
topics.try: Write a class with __enter__ / __exit__, or use @contextmanager.

topics.name: type hints
topics.try: Write def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:.

topics.name: *args and **kwargs
topics.try: Write a function total(*numbers) that adds any amount of numbers.

levels.name: Testing & Real Projects
levels.project: Capstone: a weather or currency app that calls an API, with tests.

topics.name: unit tests (unittest / pytest)
topics.try: Write a unittest.TestCase that checks your add() function.

topics.name: assert
topics.try: Add assert add(2, 3) == 5 to a script.

topics.name: calling a web API (requests / urllib)
topics.try: Fetch a JSON API with requests.get() and print one field.

topics.name: if __name__ == '__main__'
topics.try: Put your program's start code under if __name__ == '__main__':.

topics.name: command-line arguments (argparse / sys.argv)
topics.try: Accept a file name from the command line with argparse.
